findings.evidence: The equivalence is declared at lines 112–126; the only related coordinate statement is the internal definition of `integerCoordinatesLinearMap` at lines 85–109, and no `integerCoordinatesLinearEquiv_apply` or inverse lemma exists.

findings.fix: Mark all three formulas `@[simp]`; their right-hand sides eliminate the corresponding operator applications and do not create loops.

summary: The lattice equivalence and operator formulas lack the characteristic interface and automation needed by downstream consumers.
